notes: Share-page text in which a code fence opens on the speaker line itself and closes two lines later, in both turns. The line between the fences is a word that pages print as a button label: 'Report', 'Retry'.

Apple discards the text after the header whenever more text follows, and removes a label line also inside a fenced block: each turn is left with its closing fence alone, and 'Report' and 'Retry' are stored nowhere. The web app reads the lines of a turn twice, alone and with the text of the speaker line in front, and never removes a line that either reading puts inside a closed fenced block. Read alone, the turn begins with a line that is no preview target for the fence, so the fence stays the first line of its turn and the block is kept whole.
